name: Sidhant Gupta
bio: Sidhant Gupta (born 23 April 1989) is an Indian actor who predominantly works in Hindi television and films. He made his film debut in 2012 with Tutiya Dil and rose to prominence through Zee TV's soap opera Tashan-e-Ishq (2015–2016) playing Kunj Sarna. He also starred in the films Bhoomi (2017) and Operation Romeo (2022). Gupta has since had leading roles in the streaming series Jubilee (2023) and Freedom at Midnight (2024).
